1.name: Aura of Vampirism
1.description: Envelop your party in a vampiric aura, granting them a chance to activate Vampirism on melee and ranged attacks. (L1) to 30 (L60) damage and healing. Vampirism: Leech the life force of your target, dealing 1 (L1) to 30 (L60) Corruption Damage and restoring Health by the same amount. This ability persists until canceled.

1.name: Locate Corpse
1.description: Link the soul of your target to its corporeal form, revealing the direction of their corpse in the current zone.

1.name: Polar Align: North
1.description: Magically align yourself, orienting you toward the North Pole.

1.name: Shadow Strike
1.description: Unleash a shadow strike upon your target, dealing 100% Weapon Ratio Damage plus 1 (L1) to 5 (L8) Corruption Damage and increasing your Threat against them by 20 (L1) to 200 (L60). Additionally, this ability extends the duration of any spell in the Swirling Shadows line on the target by 6 seconds.
1.valuesSummary: 100% weapon dmg · 1–5 Corruption dmg (L1–L8) · +20–200 Threat against them (L1–L60)

1.name: Taunt
1.description: Taunt your target, drawing their attention. This ability has additional effects in PvP. This ability is moderately difficult to resist.

1.name: Theft of Vigor
1.description: Thieve vigor from your target, decreasing their Strength and Stamina by 2 and increading yours by the same amount for 5 minutes.

2.name: Soulrend
2.description: Leech the life force of your target, dealing 3 (L1) to 5 (L4) Corruption Damage and restoring your Health by the same amount. This spell is slightly difficult to resist.

2.name: Spirit Break
2.description: Break the spiritual defenses of your target, decreasing their Corruption, Holy, and Magic Resistance by 1 (L1) to 2 (L8) for 5 minutes. This spell cannot be resisted unless the target is immune to Magic effects.

3.name: Faltering Pulse
3.description: Terrify your target, disrupting their heartbeat for 24 seconds to lower their Agility by 2 and causing damage every 6 seconds that increases from 1 to 6.

3.name: Kick
3.description: Swiftly kick your target, interrupting their casting and preventing them from casting spells from the same school of magic for 2 seconds.

4.name: Goading Bash
4.description: Haughtily bash your target with your shield as you mock them, interrupting their spell casting and generating extra Threat against any target you block for the next 30 seconds.

5.name: Invisibility versus Undead
5.description: Shroud a target party member in darkness, rendering them unseen by undead for 10 minutes. This spell has a moderate chance to end early.

5.name: Lull the Dead
5.description: Lull a target undead, reducing their Aggro Radius for 2 minutes. This spell has a very slight chance to end early.

6.name: Grip of Shadow
6.description: Reach into the shadows and grip your target, pulling them toward you, drawing their attention, and interrupting their casting.

7.name: Cold Protection
7.description: Ward yourself against frost, increasing your Cold Resistance by 5 for 35 minutes.

7.name: Holy Protection
7.description: Ward yourself against the divine, increasing your Holy Resistance by 5 for 35 minutes.

8.name: Grip of Agony
8.description: Grip your target in writhing agony, dealing 12 (L1) to 384 (L60) damage. This ability cannot be resisted.

8.name: Soulrend II
8.description: Draw the life force of your target, dealing 9 (L4) to 11 (L7) Corruption Damage and restoring your Health by the same amount. This spell is slightly difficult to resist.

8.name: Shadow Strike II
8.description: Unleash a shadow strike upon your target, dealing 105% Weapon Ratio Damage plus 5 (L8) to 10 (L21) Corruption Damage and increasing your Threat against them by 20 (L1) to 200 (L60). Additionally, this ability extends the duration of any spell in the Swirling Shadows line on the target by 6 seconds.
8.valuesSummary: 105% weapon dmg · 5–10 Corruption dmg (L8–L21) · +20–200 Threat against them (L1–L60)

8.name: Siphoning Slash
8.description: Strike your target, dealing 110% Weapon Ratio Damage plus 5 (L8) to 10 (L20) Corruption Damage, and healing yourself for 50% of the damage done. Getting a killing blow with this ability will siphon the target's soul, creating a Soul Remnant in your inventory.

8.name: Soul Servant
8.description: Invoke the spirit of a lost soul, binding its soul to serve you. This pet uses the abilities Strike and Provoke. This spell persists until the death of the pet or master. This spell requires a Soul Remnant.

10.name: Aura of the Unholy
10.description: Surround yourself in an unholy aura, increasing your Threat generated by 10%, Parry Chance by 5% and your group's Holy Resistance by 5. Additionally, when your health falls below 25% of it's maximum, call upon an Unholy Pact to protect you. Unholy Pact: Reduce all incoming damage by 10%, increase the health returned by your Soulrend lifetap spells by 50%, and grant life steal to the Grip of Agony ability. This ability persists until canceled.

10.name: Lord of Shadows
10.description: Invoke the power of shadows, increasing your Intelligence by 2 (L10) to 15 (L60), Armor Class by 5 (L10) to 30 (L60), Hit Points by 10 (L10) to 150 (L60), and granting you 1 (L1) to 4 (L60) Mana Regeneration for 1 hour.

10.name: Pulling Shadows
10.description: Conjure pulling shadows that grip your target, dealing 3 Corruption Damage every 6 seconds and decreasing their Movement Speed by 30% for 24 seconds.

10.name: Reave
10.description: Reave your target, dealing 150% Weapon Ratio Damage plus 1 (L10) to 10 (L20) Corruption Damage. This ability requires a two handed weapon. This ability shares a cooldown with your Siphoning Strike ability.

10.name: Terror in the Shadows
10.description: Cause nearby targets to cower in terror, stunning them for 10 seconds. This spell has a slight chance to be removed by damage.

12.name: Feign Death (Spell)
12.description: Play dead, clearing all Threat from aggressive targets. This spell has a slight chance to fail. This spell has a chance to re-aggro targets when canceled.

13.name: Fear

entries.description: Tap the life force of your target, dealing 212 Corruption Damage and restoring your Health by the same amount. This spell is moderately difficult to resist.

entries.name: Sacrificial Embrace
entries.description: Transfer life force to your target, restoring 68 Health and draining yours by the same amount.

entries.name: Theft of Vigor IV
entries.description: Thieve vigor from your target, decreasing their Strength and Stamina by 15 and increading yours by the same amount for 5 minutes.

entries.name: Reave V
entries.description: Reave your target, dealing 200% Weapon Ratio Damage plus 40 (L50) to 60 (L60) Corruption Damage. This ability requires a two handed weapon. This ability shares a cooldown with your Siphoning Strike Ability.

entries.name: Beleaguer the Dead
entries.description: Beleaguer a target undead with a blast of energy, dealing 225 Holy Damage.

entries.name: Fibrillation
entries.description: Terrify your target, disrupting their heartbeat for 24 seconds to lower their Agility by 16 and causing damage every 6 seconds that increases from 1 to 324.

entries.name: Shadow Strike V
entries.description: Unleash a shadow strike upon your target, dealing 125% Weapon Ratio Damage plus 20 (L55) to 30 (L60) Corruption Damage and increasing your Threat against them by 20 (L1) to 200 (L60). Additionally, this ability extends the duration of any spell in the Swirling Shadows line on the target by 6 seconds.
entries.valuesSummary: 125% weapon dmg · 20–30 Corruption dmg (L55–L60) · +20–200 Threat against them (L1–L60)

entries.name: Siphoning Slash V
entries.description: Strike your target, dealing 160% Weapon Ratio Damage plus 40 Corruption Damage, and healing yourself for 50% of the damage done. Getting a killing blow with this ability will siphon the target's soul, creating a Soul Remnant in your inventory.

entries.name: Soul Servant IV
entries.description: Invoke the spirit of a lost soul, binding its soul to serve you. This pet uses the abilities Strike and Provoke. This spell persists until the death of the pet or master. This spell requires a Soul Remnant.

entries.name: Smothering Shadows
entries.description: Conjure smothering shadows that grip your target, dealing 45 Corruption Damage every 6 seconds and decreasing their Movement Speed by 65% for 54 seconds.

entries.name: Soulrend VI
entries.description: Guzzle the life force of your target, dealing 320 Corruption Damage and restoring your Health by the same amount. This spell is moderately difficult to resist.

entries.name: Spirit Fracture
entries.description: Fracture the spiritual defenses of your target, decreasing their Corruption, Holy, and Magic Resistance by 7 (L40) to 8 (L44) for 5 minutes. This spell cannot be resisted unless the target is immune to Magic effects.
